verifications.claim: Chipotle is closed on Easter Sunday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "We are closed for Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day." (R1); "Chipotle restaurants will be closed on Easter, a company spokesperson confirmed to USA TODAY." (R2); "Chipotle — All Chipotle locations will be closed on Easter Sunday" (R3); "Chipotle is closed on Easter, a company spokesperson told USA TODAY." (R4); "Chipotle restaurants will be closed on Easter Sunday." (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources, including official company statements and spokespersons, directly confirm Chipotle closes on Easter Sunday.

verifications.claim: All locations nationwide close for Easter Sunday as part of their standard holiday schedule.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "All Chipotle locations will be closed on Easter Sunday as part of their standard holiday schedule." (R3); "Chipotle restaurants will be closed on Easter" (R2, R4, R5); "We are closed for Easter" (R1)
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly matches the claim verbatim; other sources confirm closure without contradiction, implying nationwide policy.

verifications.claim: Chipotle locations close on Easter Sunday to allow employees the day off.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm closure on Easter but provide no information on the reason being for employees' day off (reason stated for other chains like Firehouse Subs in R3).

verifications.claim: Chipotle is typically closed on Thanksgiving.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "We are closed for Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day." (R1, official answer); multiple employee confirmations of Thanksgiving closure (R1)
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly states closure on Thanksgiving as standard, from company and employees.
